# Tom Fabre

> Tom Fabre is a product and brand designer based in Madrid and co-founder of Binōme Studio. He designs brands, websites and digital products (branding, web design, UX/UI, strategy) with more than ten years of experience between Latin America and Europe. He works in Spanish, French and English and is available for new projects.

The portfolio has real URLs per language: Spanish at the root, English under /en/ and French under /fr/. Each project below links to its detail page. Full text of every project in all three languages is in llms-full.txt; structured data is in portfolio.json.

## About

- [Bio](https://tomfabre.github.io/en/bio/): Background, way of working, quick facts and personal links.
- [Contact](https://tomfabre.github.io/en/contact/): Email hola@tomfabre.com, contact form and profile links.
- [CV (PDF)](https://tomfabre.github.io/cv-alvaro-fabre.pdf): Curriculum vitae.

## Projects

- [Contazara](https://tomfabre.github.io/en/projects/contazara/): Branding · Creative direction · Web. Refreshing the visual world of an established industrial company, creating a contemporary and consistent identity across brand and digital experiences.
- [Carceral Ecologies](https://tomfabre.github.io/en/projects/carceral/): Web design. Web design for Carceral Ecologies: a clear structure so the content can be read, explored and remembered.
- [À2pas](https://tomfabre.github.io/en/projects/a2pas/): Branding · Web design. Identity and website for À2pas: a close, recognisable brand with a consistent digital presence.
- [Happylife](https://tomfabre.github.io/en/projects/happylife/): UX/UI · Mental health app. Designing the experience of a mental health app: support with calm, clarity and a human tone.
- [Binōme Studio](https://tomfabre.github.io/en/projects/binome/): Brand · Web. Identity and website for Binōme, the design studio I run in Madrid with my partner.
- [Yaypegs](https://tomfabre.github.io/en/projects/yaypegs/): Digital design. Digital design for Yaypegs: a clear experience with personality that's easy to use.
- [360estudio](https://tomfabre.github.io/en/projects/360estudio/): Branding · Web design · Art direction. Creating a visual and digital experience that gives the studio's projects room to shine while expressing its distinctive personality.
- [Figy](https://tomfabre.github.io/en/projects/figy/): Digital design. Digital design for Figy: a clear, consistent experience from start to finish.
- [Apolo](https://tomfabre.github.io/en/projects/apolo/): App · Android launcher. The interface of an accessible, highly customisable Android launcher with 3M+ downloads.
- [Appy](https://tomfabre.github.io/en/projects/appy/): App · Onboarding. A shorter onboarding that reduced drop-off for 500K+ users.
- [Mood Messenger](https://tomfabre.github.io/en/projects/mood/): App · Messaging. Messaging flows redesigned to prioritise personalisation and retention, with 5M+ downloads.
- [Molyb](https://tomfabre.github.io/en/projects/molyb/): Educational platform. An interactive educational platform that made complex technical content accessible.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://tomfabre.github.io/en/services/): Three ways to move a good idea forward.
- [Branding & identity](https://tomfabre.github.io/en/services/branding/): A brand with something to say. I build and evolve brand identities that help businesses become recognizable, stand apart and connect with the right people.
- [Web design & development](https://tomfabre.github.io/en/services/web-design/): A good website should do more than look good. I design and build websites that communicate clearly, work smoothly and help turn visits into opportunities.
- [Digital product, UX/UI & digital strategy](https://tomfabre.github.io/en/services/ux-ui-design/): Less friction. More purpose. I design and improve digital experiences so they're intuitive, useful and easy to navigate, without losing sight of business goals.
